open.text: the god of fire couldn't burn *this.*

script: The gods won a great battle, and got proud. We did this. Then a strange being appeared. Agni, the god of fire, stepped up: I can burn anything on earth. The being set down a single blade of grass. Burn this. Agni threw everything he had at it. Nothing. He couldn't burn it. Then the being vanished, and a goddess told them: your power was never yours. It was borrowed, from the source of everything. That's why Hindus wave a flame in arti. It's light, offered back to where light comes from. Your wins are borrowed light too. Offer them back. Then share them.
